items.title: Special termination right due to price increase (must arrive before new price starts)
items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag in Textform erreichen; Kosten entstehen Ihnen dadurch nicht.
items.computation: The letter announces new prices effective 01.01.2027 and grants a special fristlos (extraordinary) right of termination tied to this increase, also effective 01.01.2027. It explicitly states the cancellation (in Textform) must reach the provider 'vor diesem Tag', i.e. before 01.01.2027. The last calendar day on which it can still arrive is therefore the day before, 31.12.2026. 31.12.2026 is a Thursday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so no shift is needed.

warnings: The letter is a private company's price-increase notice, not an authority's decision, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule or Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung applies; the stated special cancellation deadline (must arrive before 01.01.2027, i.e. by 31.12.2026) is the only firm date to act on.
Only the old and new unit prices/base charge/monthly instalment are listed under 'amounts'; these are tariff rates, not a single payable sum.
